Public website images supplement native screenshot layout, and native photo order is based on native captures. The complete lower webpage, Previous/further Next, browser actions, full result scrolling, free input, other dates and full visual fidelity remain incomplete. Independent Room start has no Home caller. Tuesday Available-to-All is not the observed Sunday action. Agent replay is not native observation or human evaluation.
